history.summary: Compact freehold 3BR (only 872sqft) at Haig Residences, a small 2011 D15 development, at $1.70M / $1,950 PSF — a high PSF for a squeezed 3-bed layout, with an unreliable 8.1% URA rate (5 txns) and a weak score (451). Freehold + East Coast location are the appeal; size efficiency and thin data are the concerns.
history.rating_rationale: $1,950 PSF is well above the project's $1,682 URA median and high for a small 872sqft '3BR' (cramped per-room). The 8.13%/yr URA figure rests on just 5 txns — essentially noise, not a forward rate. Score 451 / Elo 1215 with a losing 321-243 record. Marine Parade MRT is 1.1km (not walkable). Freehold tenure and deep D15 demand support resale, but the PSF premium over median and tiny size temper upside.
red_flags: URA 8.1% rate from only 5 txns — unreliable
$1,950 PSF is ~16% above project URA median
catalysts: East Coast / Marine Parade lifestyle and TEL access
